narrative.step_0_text: You wake up in a thick mist. You don't know who you are or how you got here. Before you, you see the outlines of three figures. Which one attracts you the most?
narrative.step_0_choice_0: A figure in heavy armor with a greatsword
narrative.step_0_choice_1: A cloaked figure with sparking magic around them
narrative.step_0_choice_2: A figure in the shadows with daggers in hand
narrative.step_1_text: The figure approaches you. You feel a strange energy from them. Suddenly, a loud roar echoes from the forest. How do you react?
narrative.step_1_choice_0: Immediately draw your weapon and prepare for battle
narrative.step_1_choice_1: Quickly hide and evaluate the situation
narrative.step_1_choice_2: Use magic to create a protective barrier

Lore: In times of darkness, legends are born. Will you be one of them, or will you fall into oblivion like those before you?
Your journey begins now. Every decision shapes your destiny.
Machala calls its heroes. Do you answer the call?
Danger lurks around every corner, but with courage comes glory.
Ancient legends speak of heroes who changed the fate of the world. Your story begins here.

human.name: Human
human.description: Versatile and adaptable warriors. Humans are known for their balance in all aspects of combat. They have good health and decent magic abilities.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Resilient and strong warriors from underground halls. Dwarves are masters of smithing and defense. Their robust bodies can take much more punishment.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Fast and magically gifted forest dwellers. Elves have an innate affinity for magic and nature. They are masters of archery and elemental magic.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Brutal strength of the wilderness. Orcs are the strongest race in close combat. Their muscles and fury have no competition in war.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Small but agile and clever. Halflings are masters of evasion and surprise strikes from the shadows. Their small size makes them excellent rogues.
halfling.bonuses: +6 Agility, higher evasion and crit chance

drak.name: Dragon
drak.description: Heirs of ancient power. They combine magic with physical prowess.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Master of close combat and heavy armor. Warriors are frontal fighters trained in the use of all weapons.
warrior.bonuses: Total +5 Strength, +5 Stamina, heavy armor proficiency

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.description: Holy protector with magic and defense. Paladins combine combat skills with healing and protective magic.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Fast killer from the shadows. Rogues are masters of stealth and critical strikes. They rely on speed and precision.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Master of mystic forces and destructive magic. Mages control elemental magic - fire, ice, lightning. They are physically weak.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Archer and tracker of the wilderness. Rangers are connected to nature and master ranged combat.

monk.name: Monk
monk.description: Master of martial arts and inner peace. Monks rely on agility and spirit.

benefits: Create your hero from 6 races and classes
